descriptions.Fungal infection: Fungal infection is a common skin condition caused by fungi.
descriptions.Allergy: Allergy is an immune system reaction to a substance in the environment.
descriptions.GERD: GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) is a digestive disorder that affects the lower esophageal sphincter.
descriptions.Chronic cholestasis: Chronic cholestasis is a condition where bile flow from the liver is reduced for a prolonged period.
descriptions.Drug Reaction: Drug Reaction occurs when the body reacts adversely to a medication.
descriptions.Peptic ulcer disease: Peptic ulcer disease involves sores that develop on the inner lining of the stomach and small intestine.
descriptions.AIDS: AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) is a disease caused by HIV that weakens the immune system.
descriptions.Diabetes: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body processes blood sugar.
descriptions.Gastroenteritis: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically caused by a virus or bacteria.
descriptions.Bronchial Asthma: Bronchial Asthma is a respiratory condition characterized by inflammation of the airways.
descriptions.Hypertension: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a common cardiovascular condition.
descriptions.Migraine: Migraine is a type of headache that often involves severe pain and sensitivity to light and sound.
descriptions.Cervical spondylosis: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine.
descriptions.Paralysis (brain hemorrhage): Paralysis (brain hemorrhage) refers to the loss of muscle function due to bleeding in the brain.
descriptions.Jaundice: Jaundice is a yellow discoloration of the skin and eyes, often indicating liver problems.
descriptions.Malaria: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease affecting humans and other animals.
descriptions.Chicken pox: Chicken pox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy rash.
descriptions.Dengue: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing flu-like symptoms.
descriptions.Typhoid: Typhoid is a bacterial infection that can lead to a high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms.
descriptions.hepatitis A: hepatitis A is a viral liver disease.
descriptions.Hepatitis B: Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver.
descriptions.Hepatitis C: Hepatitis C is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.
descriptions.Hepatitis D: Hepatitis D is a serious liver disease caused by the hepatitis D virus.
descriptions.Hepatitis E: Hepatitis E is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.
descriptions.Alcoholic hepatitis: Alcoholic hepatitis is inflammation of the liver due to alcohol consumption.
descriptions.Tuberculosis: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs.
descriptions.Common Cold: Common Cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.
descriptions.Pneumonia: Pneumonia is an inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs in the lungs.
descriptions.Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles): Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles) is a condition characterized by swollen blood vessels in the rectum.
descriptions.Heart attack: Heart attack is a sudden and severe reduction in blood flow to the heart muscle.
descriptions.Varicose veins: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins that usually appear on the legs.
descriptions.Hypothyroidism: Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone.
descriptions.Hyperthyroidism: Hyperthyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland produces too much thyroid hormone.
descriptions.Hypoglycemia: Hypoglycemia is a condition characterized by abnormally low blood sugar levels.
descriptions.Osteoarthristis: Osteoarthristis is a degenerative joint disease that affects the cartilage in joints.
descriptions.Arthritis: Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness.
descriptions.(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo: (Vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo is a type of dizziness caused by specific head movements.
descriptions.Acne: Acne is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells.
descriptions.Urinary tract infection: Urinary tract infection is an infection in any part of the urinary system.
descriptions.Psoriasis: Psoriasis is a chronic skin condition characterized by red, itchy, and scaly patches.
descriptions.Impetigo: Impetigo is a highly contagious skin infection causing red sores that can break open.

Psoriasis: Wash hands with warm soapy water
Impetigo: Soak affected area in warm water
Remove scabs with wet compressed cloth
Cervical spondylosis: Use heating pad or cold pack
Varicose veins: Lie down flat and raise the leg high
Fungal infection: Use detol or neem in bathing water
Jaundice: Eat fruits and high fiberous food
Gastroenteritis: Stop eating solid food for while
Try taking small sips of water

workup.test_name: Dix-Hallpike Bedside Diagnostic Maneuver
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm posterior canal canalithiasis nystagmus

workup.test_name: Audiometry & Vestibular Function Testing
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess for coexisting inner ear pathology

workup.test_name: 4th Generation HIV-1/2 Ag/Ab Immunoassay
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect HIV p24 antigen and specific antibodies

workup.test_name: CD4+ T-Lymphocyte Count & Plasma HIV-1 RNA Viral Load
workup.clinical_purpose: Staging of immunosuppression and baseline viral replication

workup.test_name: Clinical Dermatological Lesion Grading
workup.clinical_purpose: Grade comedones, papules, pustules, and nodulocystic lesions

workup.test_name: Serum Total/Free Testosterone & DHEAS (if hyperandrogenism signs)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate endocrine hyperandrogenic etiology

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Liver Function Panel (AST/ALT ratio > 2:1, Bilirubin)
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify hepatocellular necrosis and calculate Maddrey's DF

workup.test_name: Coagulation Profile (PT/INR) & Serum Albumin
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess hepatic synthetic capacity and coagulopathy

workup.test_name: Abdominal Ultrasound with Doppler
workup.clinical_purpose: Rule out biliary obstruction, portal vein thrombosis, and ascites

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count (Absolute Eosinophil Count - AEC)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate peripheral eosinophilia

workup.test_name: Total Serum IgE & Allergen-Specific IgE
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify atopic predisposition and specific aeroallergen triggers

workup.test_name: Inflammatory Markers (ESR & High-Sensitivity CRP)
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify systemic synovitis and inflammatory activity

workup.test_name: Rheumatoid Factor (RF) & Anti-CCP Antibodies
workup.clinical_purpose: Differentiate autoimmune rheumatoid arthritis from degenerative arthropathy

workup.test_name: Plain Radiograph (X-Ray) of Symptomatic Joints
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect erosions, joint space narrowing, and periarticular osteopenia

workup.test_name: Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR) & Pulse Oximetry (SpO2)
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess airflow limitation and hypoxemia severity

workup.test_name: Pre- and Post-Bronchodilator Spirometry (FEV1/FVC)
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm reversible obstructive airway defect

workup.test_name: Chest Radiograph (CXR PA View)
workup.clinical_purpose: Exclude pneumothorax, consolidation, or foreign body aspiration

workup.test_name: Cervical Spine Plain Radiographs (AP, Lateral, Oblique views)
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess disc space narrowing, osteophytes, and neural foramen stenosis

workup.test_name: Spurling's Bedside Test & Upper Limb Neurological Reflexes
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate cervical nerve root compression and myelopathic signs

workup.test_name: Clinical Dermatological Pleomorphic Rash Assessment
workup.clinical_purpose: Verify simultaneous macules, papules, vesicles ('dewdrops on rose petal') and crusts

workup.test_name: VZV PCR / Tzanck Smear from Unroofed Vesicle
workup.clinical_purpose: Microscopic and molecular confirmation in atypical cases

workup.test_name: Serum Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) & GGT with Direct Bilirubin
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm cholestatic enzymatic pattern and biliary excretion defect

workup.test_name: High-Resolution Abdominal Ultrasound / MRCP
workup.clinical_purpose: Distinguish intrahepatic cholestasis from extrahepatic mechanical obstruction

workup.test_name: Anterior Rhinoscopy & Oropharyngeal Examination
workup.clinical_purpose: Rule out acute streptococcal pharyngitis, sinusitis, or otitis media

Dengue.topic: Dengue Fever with Warning Signs Triage

workup.test_name: Dengue NS1 Antigen (Day 1-5) & Dengue IgM/IgG Serology
workup.clinical_purpose: Serological confirmation of acute flavivirus viremia

workup.test_name: Serial Complete Blood Count (Hematocrit & Platelet Count)
workup.clinical_purpose: Monitor hemoconcentration (>20% rise in Hct) and acute thrombocytopenia (<100,000)

workup.test_name: Bedside Focused Ultrasound (FAST) for Plasma Leakage
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect subclinical ascites, gallbladder wall thickening, and pleural effusion

workup.test_name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) & Fasting Plasma Glucose (FPG)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate 3-month glycemic control and fasting hyperglycemia

workup.test_name: Serum Creatinine, eGFR & Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (UACR)
workup.clinical_purpose: Screen for diabetic nephropathy and microalbuminuria

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Diabetic Foot & Monofilament Sensory Exam
workup.clinical_purpose: Screen for peripheral sensory neuropathy and vasculopathy

workup.test_name: Digital Rectal Examination (DRE) & Anoscopy / Proctoscopy
workup.clinical_purpose: Grade internal piles (Grade I-IV) and evaluate for thrombosis/fissure

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count (Hemoglobin & Hematocrit)
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess severity of iron deficiency anemia from chronic per-rectal bleeding

Drug Reaction.topic: Adverse Cutaneous Drug Reaction / Drug Eruption

workup.test_name: Medication Timeline & Dechallenge Chronology Audit
workup.clinical_purpose: Pinpoint offending causative pharmaceutical agent

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count with Absolute Eosinophil Count
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess eosinophilia and rule out DRESS syndrome

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (Liver & Renal Function)
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect occult visceral organ involvement

workup.test_name: 10-20% Potassium Hydroxide (KOH) Mount of Active Margin Scrapings
workup.clinical_purpose: Demonstrate branching septate hyphae and arthroconidia

workup.test_name: Wood's Lamp Ultraviolet Examination
workup.clinical_purpose: Rule out Corynebacterium erythrasma and tinea versicolor fluorescence

workup.test_name: Diagnostic Upper GI Endoscopy (Esophagogastroduodenoscopy - EGD)
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify mucosal erosions, Los Angeles grade reflux, Barrett's esophagus

workup.test_name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG) & Baseline Cardiac Check
workup.clinical_purpose: Unambiguously rule out acute ischemic heart disease presenting as heartburn

workup.test_name: Stool Routine, Microscopy & Occult Blood
workup.clinical_purpose: Differentiate secretory viral watery diarrhea from invasive dysentery (pus cells, RBCs)

workup.test_name: Serum Electrolytes (Sodium, Potassium, Bicarbonate) & Creatinine
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify dehydration-induced hypokalemia, metabolic acidosis, and pre-renal AKI

workup.test_name: Stat 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG within 10 minutes of arrival)
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify ST-segment elevation, pathological Q-waves, or new LBBB

workup.test_name: High-Sensitivity Cardiac Troponin I/T (Serial 0h / 1h / 3h)
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm acute myocardial necrosis and dynamic rise/fall curve

workup.test_name: Bedside Focused Transthoracic Echocardiogram (Echo)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate regional wall motion abnormalities (RWMA) and ejection fraction

workup.test_name: Hepatitis B Serology Panel (HBsAg, Anti-HBs, Anti-HBc IgM & Total)
workup.clinical_purpose: Differentiate acute infection from chronic carrier state

workup.test_name: Quantitative HBV DNA Viral Load (Real-Time PCR)
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify circulating viral burden for antiviral therapy eligibility

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Liver Function Panel & Abdominal Sonogram
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess transaminase surge and structural parenchymal changes

workup.test_name: Anti-HCV Antibody Screening Immunoassay
workup.clinical_purpose: Initial serological detection of exposure to Hepatitis C virus

workup.test_name: Quantitative HCV RNA PCR (Viral Load & Genotyping)
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm active ongoing viral replication prior to Direct Acting Antivirals (DAAs)

workup.test_name: Transient Elastography (FibroScan) / APRI Score
workup.clinical_purpose: Stage hepatic fibrosis and rule out established cirrhosis

workup.test_name: Anti-HDV Total & IgM Antibodies with HBsAg
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect co-infection or superinfection in HBsAg-positive individuals

workup.test_name: HDV RNA Quantitative Real-Time RT-PCR
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify Delta virus viremia and disease activity

workup.test_name: Coagulation Profile (PT/INR) & Serial Transaminases
workup.clinical_purpose: Monitor for fulminant hepatic failure

workup.test_name: Anti-HEV IgM Serology (ELISA)
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm acute waterborne Hepatitis E viral infection

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Liver Function Tests (Total Bilirubin, AST, ALT, ALP)
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess depth of cholestatic jaundice and hepatic inflammation

workup.test_name: Obstetric & Fetal Well-being Ultrasound (if pregnant patient)
workup.clinical_purpose: HEV carries up to 25% maternal mortality in pregnancy; requires stat monitoring

workup.test_name: Standardized Protocol Blood Pressure Measurement (both arms)
workup.clinical_purpose: Stage hypertension per AHA/ESC guidelines (Stage 1 vs Stage 2 vs Crisis)

workup.test_name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
workup.clinical_purpose: Screen for left ventricular hypertrophy (Sokolow-Lyon voltage)

workup.test_name: Serum Creatinine, eGFR, Fasting Lipid Panel & Urine Microalbumin
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect target organ damage and overall 10-year atherosclerotic risk

workup.test_name: Complete Thyroid Panel (Serum TSH, Free T3, Free T4)
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm thyrotoxicosis (suppressed TSH <0.01 with elevated FT3/FT4)

workup.test_name: Anti-TSH Receptor Antibodies (TRAb) / Thyroid Ultrasound
workup.clinical_purpose: Differentiate Graves' disease from toxic multinodular goiter or thyroiditis

workup.test_name: 12-Lead ECG for Tachyarrhythmias
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect sinus tachycardia or atrial fibrillation

workup.test_name: Stat Point-of-Care Capillary Blood Glucose (Fingerstick)
workup.clinical_purpose: Immediate bedside confirmation of blood sugar < 70 mg/dL (< 3.9 mmol/L)

workup.test_name: Laboratory Venous Plasma Glucose & Serum Electrolytes
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirmatory venous quantification and rule out electrolyte imbalance

workup.test_name: Plasma Insulin, C-Peptide, & Sulfonylurea Screen (if non-diabetic)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate for insulinoma, factitious hypoglycemia, or oral hypoglycemic overdose

workup.test_name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (Serum TSH) & Free T4
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm primary hypothyroidism (elevated TSH with low FT4)

workup.test_name: Anti-Thyroid Peroxidase (Anti-TPO) Antibodies
workup.clinical_purpose: Confirm Hashimoto's autoimmune thyroiditis etiology

workup.test_name: Fasting Lipid Profile & Complete Blood Count
workup.clinical_purpose: Screen for secondary dyslipidemia and normocytic/macrocytic anemia

workup.test_name: Clinical Dermatological Crusting & Lesion Assessment
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify pathognomonic honey-colored 'stuck-on' crusts

workup.test_name: Bacterial Exudate Swab Gram Stain & Culture/Sensitivity
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify S. aureus or S. pyogenes and test methicillin resistance (MRSA)

workup.test_name: Fractionated Serum Bilirubin (Total, Direct/Conjugated, Indirect)
workup.clinical_purpose: Classify pre-hepatic (hemolytic), hepatocellular, or post-hepatic (obstructive)

workup.test_name: Comprehensive Liver Enzyme Panel (AST, ALT, ALP, GGT, Total Protein, Albumin)
workup.clinical_purpose: Differentiate acute viral/toxic transaminitis from cholestasis

workup.test_name: Abdominal Ultrasonography (Hepatobiliary Ultrasound)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate common bile duct diameter, gallstones, and liver echogenicity

workup.test_name: Peripheral Blood Smear for Malaria Parasite (Thick & Thin Giemsa Stain)
workup.clinical_purpose: Gold standard parasitemia identification and species differentiation (Pv vs Pf)

workup.test_name: Rapid Diagnostic Test (Malaria RDT for Pf-HRP2 & Pan-pLDH)
workup.clinical_purpose: Rapid point-of-care antigen detection within 15 minutes

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count with Platelet Count & Hemoglobin
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess severity of malarial hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia

workup.test_name: Detailed Neurological Cranial Nerve & Funduscopic Examination
workup.clinical_purpose: Rule out papilledema, focal neurological deficits, and secondary etiologies

workup.test_name: Headache SNOOP4 Checklist & Migraine Severity Score (MIDAS)
workup.clinical_purpose: Classify episodic vs chronic migraine and assess functional disability

workup.test_name: Weight-Bearing Plain Radiography (X-Ray) of Affected Joints
workup.clinical_purpose: Kellgren-Lawrence grading (joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, osteophytes)

workup.test_name: Inflammatory Markers (ESR & CRP - typically normal in OA)
workup.clinical_purpose: Rule out inflammatory autoimmune or infectious arthropathy

workup.test_name: Stat Non-Contrast Computed Tomography of Brain (NCCT Head <20 mins)
workup.clinical_purpose: Distinguish hyperdense acute intracerebral hemorrhage from ischemic infarction

workup.test_name: NIH Stroke Scale (NIHSS) & Continuous Neurological GCS Scoring
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify neurological deficit severity and track herniation risk

workup.test_name: Coagulation Profile (PT/INR, aPTT, Platelets) & Type and Crossmatch
workup.clinical_purpose: Guide urgent coagulopathy reversal (e.g. 4-factor PCC for warfarin/DOACs)

workup.test_name: Diagnostic Upper GI Endoscopy (EGD)
workup.clinical_purpose: Direct mucosal visualization, Forrest classification of bleeding, biopsy for malignancy

workup.test_name: Helicobacter pylori Testing (Stool Antigen or 14C Urea Breath Test)
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify active H. pylori infection requiring eradication therapy

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Serum Ferritin
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect occult gastrointestinal blood loss and microcytic anemia

workup.test_name: Chest Radiograph (CXR PA & Lateral View)
workup.clinical_purpose: Demonstrate lobar or bronchopneumonic consolidation, cavitation, or pleural effusion

workup.test_name: Complete Blood Count with Differential & Serum Procalcitonin/CRP
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify bacterial leukocytosis and systemic inflammatory kinetics

workup.test_name: Pulse Oximetry (Continuous SpO2) & CURB-65 Risk Stratification
workup.clinical_purpose: Determine OPD vs ward vs ICU admission requirement

workup.test_name: Clinical Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) & Body Surface Area (BSA)
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify plaque erythema, induration, scaling, and anatomic extent

workup.test_name: Screening for Psoriatic Arthritis (PEST Questionnaire & Joint Exam)
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect enthesitis, dactylitis, and inflammatory axial/peripheral joint disease

workup.test_name: Sputum GeneXpert MTB/RIF (CBNAAT - Molecular Assay)
workup.clinical_purpose: Rapidly detect M. tuberculosis DNA and rifampicin resistance mutations

workup.test_name: Sputum Smear Microscopy for Acid-Fast Bacilli (AFB - 2 samples)
workup.clinical_purpose: Quantify mycobacterial load and assess infectiousness

workup.test_name: Chest Radiograph (CXR PA View)
workup.clinical_purpose: Identify upper lobe apical/posterior infiltrates, cavitation, or fibrosis

workup.test_name: Automated Blood Culture (BACTEC - 10-15 mL whole blood)
workup.clinical_purpose: Diagnostic gold standard during 1st week of illness with antibiotic sensitivity

workup.test_name: Typhidot Rapid IgM/IgG Serology & Complete Blood Count
workup.clinical_purpose: Detect acute outer membrane protein antibodies; CBC reveals relative leukopenia

workup.test_name: Abdominal Ultrasonography (Hepatobiliary/Splenic)
workup.clinical_purpose: Evaluate splenomegaly and mesenteric lymphadenopathy

workup.test_name: Urine Routine & Microscopic Examination (Urine R/M)
workup.clinical_purpose: Demonstrate pyuria (>5 WBCs/hpf), bacteriuria, and leukocyte esterase/nitrites

workup.test_name: Clean Catch Midstream Urine Culture & Sensitivity (Urine C/S)
workup.clinical_purpose: Isolate uropathogen (E. coli, Klebsiella) and guide targeted antimicrobial therapy

Varicose veins.topic: Varicose Veins of Lower Extremities & Venous Reflux

workup.test_name: Venous Duplex Ultrasound (Doppler) of Lower Extremities (Standing)
workup.clinical_purpose: Map saphenofemoral/saphenopopliteal junction reflux and perforator incompetence

workup.test_name: Clinical CEAP Classification (C0-C6) & Ankle-Brachial Index (ABI)
workup.clinical_purpose: Grade disease severity and rule out coexisting arterial occlusive disease

workup.test_name: Anti-Hepatitis A Virus IgM Antibody (Anti-HAV IgM ELISA)
workup.clinical_purpose: Definitive serological marker of acute viral hepatitis A infection

workup.test_name: Complete Liver Function Panel (Total Bilirubin, AST, ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase)
workup.clinical_purpose: Assess severity of acute hepatocellular injury (ALT/AST typically > 1000 IU/L)

workup.test_name: Prothrombin Time / INR (PT/INR)
workup.clinical_purpose: Screen for acute hepatic synthetic impairment and early acute liver failure
